strategyStages.name: Read-only observe
strategyStages.purpose: UI can preview adapter data without changing runtime.
strategyStages.exitGate: Preview QA passed and lock remains valid.

strategyStages.name: Shadow compare
strategyStages.purpose: Compare current UI logic with data model output side-by-side.
strategyStages.exitGate: No mismatch or manually approved mismatch list.

strategyStages.name: Single-panel adapter input
strategyStages.purpose: One non-critical panel may read adapter output.

activationRequirements: Read-only preview lock must remain valid.
Adapter activation QA gate must pass.
No runtime replacement in the activation strategy package.
